name: Galaxy Bonita

seo.title: Galaxy Bonita Yacht Galapagos: Cruises | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Galaxy Bonita, a 16-guest Galapagos family motor yacht with 8 cabins. 4-night Southern and Eastern and 6-night Western routes, all from Baltra.

tagline: A 16-guest family yacht with three routes, all from Baltra.
answer: Galaxy Bonita is a 16-guest motor yacht that Galaxy Cruises calls a family cruise yacht, with 8 cabins, 9 crew, a cruise director and one bilingual naturalist guide. Every route starts and ends at Baltra: a 6-night Western Route and 4-night Southern and Eastern routes, from US$2,900 per person in 2026. Children over 6 on shared departures.
facts: Naturalist cruise (Galaxy's label; no class grade on the page)
Western 6 nights, Southern 4 nights, Eastern 4 nights, all Baltra round trips
Over 6 on shared departures; any age on charter (Galaxy terms)
overview: Galaxy Bonita is a motor yacht that Galaxy Cruises describes as a family cruise yacht. She takes 16 guests in eight cabins of three types.
On board there is a sundeck with 360-degree views, relaxation areas, an indoor dining room, a 24-hour coffee and tea station and a bar. Kayaks, paddleboards, snorkel gear and wetsuits are included.

Every route starts and ends at Baltra. The 6-night Western Route covers Santiago, western Isabela, Fernandina and the Santa Cruz highlands. The 4-night Southern Route covers Floreana, Espanola and San Cristobal. The 4-night Eastern Route covers South Plaza, Genovesa, Santiago and Bartolome.
why: The most affordable boat in this set, at US$2,900 per person for 4 nights in 2026, and Galaxy pitches her at families.
All three routes start at Baltra, so they join easily: Southern plus Eastern gives 8 nights covering the south and Genovesa.

pricesNote: Per person, cruise only, USD, as published on galaxycruises.com/bonita-yacht on 2 Nov 2026, labelled 2026 price: Western (6 nights) US$4,350, Southern and Eastern (4 nights) US$2,900. Occupancy basis not stated. Dated departures were not captured: Galaxy's booking feed loads in the browser and could not be read on 2 Nov 2026. Galaxy publishes 2026 itinerary prices only on the yacht page; 2027 prices are not published there.
inclusions: Airport assistance on the cruise start date
Cruise director and personalised crew service
All meals from lunch on day one to breakfast on the last day
A snack after each activity (except the last day) and a welcome cocktail
Unlimited purified water, coffee and tea
All visits, excursions and activities in the itinerary
Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, fins) and wetsuits
Transport and refuelling in the Galapagos Marine Reserve
Kayaks and paddleboards in designated areas
exclusions: International flights to and from Ecuador
Flights between Quito or Guayaquil and the Galapagos
Galapagos National Park entrance fee, US$200 per person
Transit Control Card, US$20 per person
Travel insurance (Galaxy calls it highly recommended)
children: Galaxy Cruises' terms accept children over 6 on shared departures and children of any age on a full charter; under-12s share a cabin with an adult or sleep in a cabin next to their parents. The booking form prices children aged 6 to 11 separately. Galaxy calls Bonita a family cruise yacht.
faqs: How many guests does Galaxy Bonita carry?
Sixteen, in eight cabins, with nine crew, a cruise director and one bilingual naturalist guide.
Where do Galaxy Bonita cruises start?
Every route starts and ends at Baltra.
A 6-night Western Route, a 4-night Southern Route and a 4-night Eastern Route with Genovesa.
How much does a Galaxy Bonita cruise cost?
Galaxy's 2026 prices are US$2,900 per person for 4 nights and US$4,350 for the 6-night Western Route. Flights and park fees are extra.
Is Galaxy Bonita good for families?
Galaxy calls her a family cruise yacht. Its terms accept children over 6 on shared departures and any age on a charter.
A 360-degree sundeck, an indoor dining room, a bar and a 24-hour coffee and tea station.
Galaxy's booking form offers a whole-boat charter; the price is quoted on request.
Meals, snacks, water, coffee and tea, guided excursions, snorkel gear, wetsuits, kayaks and paddleboards, and airport transfers. Drinks, tips and park fees are extra.
publishedNote: Galaxy Cruises publishes its 2026 fare for each route on the yacht's own page; 2027 fares are not published there yet. Ask us for 2027.
